metadata.title: That 1 kill where I aimed at a wall and Valorant said ‘You got this, trust me’ LOL
metadata.description:
Wait, I was aiming at the wrong spot!
Enemy just handed me a freebie like it was payday.
Click if your luck is weirder than your aim.
Valorant logic at its finest again!

Tap if your aim’s a mystery but the kills still roll in!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
